reviews.text: Charlie, my Yorkie mix came through her dental procedure beautifully. The staff was very careful with her little mouth; thanks! She's back to her prissy self now!
Love Dr. Ramien!  Best Vet in Houston
Staff got me in for an appointment quickly (within 24 hours) and resolved my serious issue the very next day.
Excellent care for my pets by vets who care
They are amazing! The only place in Houston I would take my dog for a vet visit.

Stay away from this place. I am seeking help regarding my experience with them  . I brought my dog to the clinic for semen collection and freezing after being quoted $475 and promised 1 through 4 straws.

The clinic collected the semen and expressed we had successful , but afterward I was told I would have to pay an additional $475. This second charge was not clearly disclosed or authorized before the unexpected procedure. When I questioned it and explained that the promised services had not been provided as represented, I was treated rudely rather than given a clear explanation or resolution.

I have requested an itemized invoice (never received , chargers I correctly from the beginning ) , copies of the consent and treatment records, the semen-evaluation results, and written confirmation that the sample is secure. I can provide receipts, messages, and a detailed timeline documenting the experience.

I believe other pet owners and breeders should know the importance of obtaining complete written pricing and service terms before undergoing a time-sensitive reproductive procedure. I would appreciate your consideration of this consumer complaint. In the meantime , for I have observed I would stay away from this place
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Michael! We're glad to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!

Been a loyal client here for 40 years. The great vets on staff have always been super attentive and given my dogs targeted care with productive results. However ever since the clinic's corporate takeover the last two-three years in particular have had continual price increases, making responsible pet care almost unaffordable, especially for multiple pet owners, show breeders and SENIORS. Multiple pet households and SENIORS should IMO be considered for some kind of minor discounts but not holding breath for polite corporate consideration.
